content.user_title: Build and Configure VitePress Documentation Sites
content.value_statement: VitePress projects require coordinated configuration, content, themes, data loading, and deployment. This skill provides focused guidance for building maintainable VitePress sites with Vue and Markdown.
actual_capabilities: Configure site metadata, routing, build options, and Markdown behavior through VitePress configuration.
Build navigation, sidebars, search, social links, and default theme settings.
Use Vue components, data loaders, dynamic routes, custom themes, and SSR-safe patterns.
Set up internationalization, syntax-highlighted code blocks, and custom styling.
Prepare deployments for GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Nginx, and other platforms.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples but does not execute builds or deploy sites.
Examples use placeholders and require adaptation to each repository, content model, and hosting environment.
It targets VitePress 1.x and may not cover later API changes.
Remote content and third-party scripts require independent trust, validation, and security review.

use_cases.title: Create a Product Documentation Site
use_cases.description: Plan routes, navigation, sidebars, search, and Markdown structure for a new product documentation site.

use_cases.title: Extend a VitePress Theme
use_cases.description: Add Vue components, theme slots, CSS variables, custom fonts, and SSR-safe browser integrations.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Reliable Deployment
use_cases.description: Choose build settings, base paths, output directories, and hosting configuration for a supported deployment platform.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Documentation Site
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a VitePress site for [project]. Include the page structure, navigation, sidebar groups, search choice, and required setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Configure an Existing Site
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my VitePress requirements for [site]. Propose configuration for metadata, clean URLs, navigation, sidebars, social links, and edit links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improving site configuration and theme navigation

prompt_templates.title: Design Dynamic Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Design VitePress data loaders and dynamic routes for [data source]. Explain file placement, watch patterns, route parameters, validation, and rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Generating pages from local files or remote data

prompt_templates.title: Architect an Advanced VitePress Build
prompt_templates.prompt: Architect a multilingual VitePress site with a custom theme, SSR-safe browser plugins, remote content controls, and deployment to [platform].

output_examples.input: Plan a small documentation site for a command-line application.
output: Structure: introduction, installation, command reference, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Navigation: Guide, Reference, and release repository.
Sidebar: ordered learning pages followed by command and configuration references.
Search: local search for a small self-contained site.

output_examples.input: Recommend a deployment approach for documentation hosted under a repository subpath.
output: Set the site base to the repository subpath.
Build the documentation in continuous integration.
Publish the generated VitePress distribution directory.
Verify asset links and clean URLs in the deployed preview.

output_examples.input: Review an SSR issue caused by a browser-only plugin.
output_examples.output: Load the plugin only in the browser, use a fixed dynamic import, and wrap browser-dependent rendering in an appropriate client-only boundary.

best_practices: Inspect the existing VitePress configuration and theme extensions before proposing changes.
Keep browser-only code behind SSR guards and use fixed module imports.
Validate remote data, test production builds, and verify the configured base path before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder URLs, keys, paths, or package names into production unchanged.
Do not render untrusted remote Markdown or HTML without validation and sanitization.
Do not access browser globals during server rendering without a client-only boundary.

faq.question: Which VitePress version does this skill cover?
faq.answer: The reference material targets VitePress 1.x and was generated on January 28, 2026.

faq.question: Can it create a complete VitePress configuration?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose configuration for site metadata, routing, Markdown, themes, search, navigation, and build options.

faq.question: Does it support Vue components inside Markdown?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers local and global components, script setup, runtime data, templates, styles, and SSR considerations.

faq.question: Can it help generate pages from data?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers build-time data loaders, watched local files, remote APIs, dynamic paths, parameters, and content placeholders.

faq.question: Does it deploy the site automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides deployment guidance and configuration examples, but users must run builds and manage hosting credentials.

faq.question: How should remote HTML or Markdown be handled?
faq.answer: Treat remote content as untrusted. Validate its source and sanitize dangerous markup before including it in generated pages.
